# Released verify ground reports

These reports are generated by the released `verify 0.7.6` x86_64 macOS
binary against the synthetic XML and claims in this directory. The report
fixtures are not hand-authored: each is captured from a real CLI invocation.
The downloaded `verify-v0.7.6-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz` matched SHA256SUMS at
`5a01301fbb880c6c31f0ebac9187b5b0e72dfcca593363b1777a0570d2f49e7e`.

The command shape used for every report was:

```text
verify ground <claims.jsonl> --bind filing=<document.xml> --lock <lock.v0.json> --json --no-witness
```

The refusal fixtures were emitted by the released binary for lock drift,
malformed claims, empty claims, and a missing lock. Their refusal marker is an
object; their result list is empty. A caller can still name its own constraint
set `grounding.v1`, so this structural marker is not proof of verify command
provenance.

- `document.xml` is the locked source for the PASS, FAIL, bad-claims, and
  empty-claims cases.
- `document-drift.xml` has the same logical document with a changed amount and
  is checked against the lock for the drift refusal.
- `missing-lock` is invoked with a path that does not exist.
